POSTGRES_DB.description: Name of the PostgreSQL database used by AFFiNE.

PGDATA.description: Data directory inside the container. Do not change.

REDIS_SERVER_HOST.description: Hostname of the Redis server used for AFFiNE's sync system.

AFFINE_SERVER_PORT.description: Port the AFFiNE server listens on inside the container.

AFFINE_INDEXER_ENABLED.description: Enable the full-text search indexer. Requires additional memory and setup.
